title: Vertex welding and crease-angle normals
purpose: Merge duplicate vertices within a tolerance through a spatial hash, then give a three.js mesh angle-weighted normals that stay smooth across gentle bends and split only at creases sharper than a chosen angle, keeping UV seams. Use it to clean triangle soups: smooth cylinders with sharp caps, hard-surface models.

engine.name: webgl2_browser
engine.notes: weldVertices and creaseNormals need no three.js; createCreasedGeometry takes three.js as THREE; only 0.186.1 was run.

exports.name: weldVertices
exports.signature: weldVertices(positions, tolerance = 1e-6, indices = null) -> {positions, indices, remap}
exports.summary: Unique positions within the tolerance, the triangles over them and the input-to-unique vertex map.

exports.name: creaseNormals
exports.signature: creaseNormals(positions, indices, creaseAngleDegrees = 30, options = {}) -> {positions, normals, uvs, indices}
exports.summary: Angle-weighted normals per corner from the faces within the crease angle; vertices split only where normals or uvs differ.

exports.name: createCreasedGeometry
exports.summary: A new indexed geometry with crease normals from any triangle geometry; its uv attribute is kept.

exports.name: CREASE_NORMALS_DEFAULTS
exports.summary: Frozen default tolerance and crease angle.

inputs.positions: array or typed array of x, y, z triples
inputs.indices: triangle indices, or null for a triangle soup
inputs.options: {tolerance, uvs} where uvs holds two numbers per input vertex

limits: Welding keeps the first vertex it meets in a cluster, so chains of points each within the tolerance of the next can merge differently depending on order; it does not repair holes, T-junctions or flipped faces. The crease test compares each triangle with every face around a vertex directly, not by walking the fan, so smoothing is not transitive across a vertex. Degenerate triangles take the plain average around their vertices. Attributes other than position and uv (colours, skin weights, morph targets) are dropped by createCreasedGeometry. Only three.js 0.186.1 was run, in headless Chrome on SwiftShader WebGL 2.
technique_references: Spatial hashing in tolerance-sized cells with a 27-cell neighbour search
Smoothing by a crease-angle threshold between face normals
